job.job_description:
We're Hiring: AI Agent Developer | Build the Future of Logistics Operations

Our mission is to build a digital workforce for the logistics industryAI agents that automate order entry, carrier sales, freight billing, customer service, shipment tracking, and dozens of other back-office operations. If you've ever wanted to build AI that genuinely changes how businesses work, this is your opportunity.

At SHJ International, we're building an AI-powered operations platform for the U.S. transportation and logistics industry.

Instead of building another chatbot, you'll design and develop intelligent AI agents that perform the same work currently handled by logistics coordinators, billing specialists, dispatchers, and customer service teams.

Imagine building AI agents that can...

Process customer orders from emails and PDFs

Perform Order Entry into the TMS

Find and negotiate with backhaul carriers

Validate freight invoices and automate billing

Track shipments and proactively resolve exceptions

Schedule appointments with warehouses

Communicate with customers and carriers

Read Bills of Lading, PODs, invoices and other shipping documents

Audit shipments and identify operational issues

Collaborate with other AI agents to complete entire workflows with minimal human intervention

Every agent you build will automate real business operations used daily by transportation companies across the United States.

You'll work on

AI Agents & Multi-Agent Systems
Large Language Models (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini)
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Prompt Engineering
Python / Node.js
Workflow Automation
APIs & Integrations
OCR & Document Intelligence
Vector Databases
AI Evaluation & Monitoring

We're looking for someone who...

Loves experimenting with Generative AI
Has built AI projects (personal or professional)
Is excited about AI agents and automation
Enjoys solving real operational problems
Learns quickly and takes ownership

Experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AutoGen, LangChain, n8n, or similar frameworks is a plus—but curiosity and the ability to build matter more.

Why join us?

You'll help create a digital workforce capable of automating entire logistics operations—not just assisting humans, but working alongside them.

This isn't a proof of concept.

This is production AI solving real business problems every day.

Location: Indore (On-site)
Employment: Full-Time

If you're excited about building AI that transforms how businesses operate, we'd love to hear from you.
